name: Dani Isaacsohn
office: Minority Leader, Ohio House of Representatives
stance: Wants Ohio to regulate AI despite federal pushback.

statements.text: Of course, the federal government led by President Trump isn't interested in regulating AI, which is the next frontier of technology, potentially a much more disruptive technology than social media,
We are elected to pass laws and regulate these things, that's what people expect of us,
